marketing_legal_terms_1_body: The employer portal lets businesses create a company profile, post jobs, manage candidates and use the hiring tools published for each service package.
marketing_legal_terms_2_body: Employers provide accurate information, keep their sign-in details secure and are responsible for activity on their account.
marketing_legal_terms_3_body: Job postings must be lawful, transparent about the position and must not charge candidates unlawful fees. The platform may temporarily hide content that needs verification.
marketing_legal_terms_4_body: Some features may require verifying your email, phone number, company membership or authority to represent the business through its legal documents.
marketing_legal_terms_5_body: Employers use candidate profiles only for the stated hiring purpose, never share them without authorization and must follow the data processing agreement.
marketing_legal_terms_6_body: These terms may be updated with a clear effective date. Significant changes will be announced in your account or by email to your registered address.
marketing_legal_privacy_1_body: We process account, contact person and company information, service usage history, security data and your consulting preferences.
marketing_legal_privacy_2_body: Data is used to create and protect accounts, provide hiring services, support customers, prevent fraud and meet legal obligations.
marketing_legal_privacy_3_body: Accepting the terms and privacy policy is required to provide the service. Consent to receive consulting is optional and can be changed later.
marketing_legal_privacy_4_body: Data is shared only with necessary processors, competent authorities or on valid instructions; how long it is kept depends on the purpose and legal requirements.
marketing_legal_privacy_5_title: 5. Your rights as a data subject
marketing_legal_privacy_5_body: You can request access to, correction, restriction or deletion of your data to the extent the law allows, and you will be told how your request is handled.
marketing_legal_privacy_6_body: We apply access controls, authentication and appropriate technical measures; employers should also protect their devices and sign-in details.
marketing_legal_applies_to: Applies to accounts and services on the {siteName} employer portal.
marketing_legal_intro: This document explains the core principles that apply when businesses use the platform. Any specific contracts or service appendices take precedence within their scope.
